name: @devkit/plugin
description: DevKit Claude Code plugin — MCP IR service + skills

scripts.smoke: node bin/ir-server.js --smoke && npm run smoke:critic && npm run smoke:eval && npm run smoke:render && npm run smoke:web
scripts.smoke:critic: node bin/critic.js examples/lob/order-app.ir.json > /dev/null && echo '[devkit] critic ok'
scripts.smoke:eval: node bin/eval-runner.js examples/lob/order-app.ir.json > /dev/null && echo '[devkit] eval ok'
scripts.smoke:render: node bin/render-erd.js examples/lob/order-app.ir.json > /dev/null && node bin/render-bpmn.js examples/lob/order-app.ir.json > /dev/null && echo '[devkit] renderers ok'
